I replied to Tobias in our direct message to confirm I have the note: his standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team is now Fridays at 13:15. I told him I'd keep it between us.

He said no action was needed, so I didn't add a calendar entry or tell anyone else. The workspace brain saves our direct messages automatically and shows them only to him. That means the note is there for later without me posting or saving it anywhere others could see it.
